final.report:
DELPHI's validate_generation compared the generated design "wingless-flying-fish" (a repository design id, 0 edits) with its base "flying-fish". The word "validated" is withheld. This is a report of what was and wasn't checked, not a validity claim.

Desired phenotype: "a flying fish that still glides at least 20 m from a 1 m launch after its pectoral fins are reduced to zebrafish proportions". The parser produced one hard criterion: glide_range_total_m >= 20 m at launch height 1 m, adult stage. The stage was an assumption, because none was stated. The parser did not understand part of the clause (leftover: "a that still after its pectoral fins are reduced to proportions"). That part was never checked. The parser also found no editable parameters, so an optimizer would have nothing to vary.

The five results, each on its own:
- Genotype similarity: cannot-assess. The design has no gene-level edit, so there is no allele to compare. No sequence was assessed and 0 loci were covered. This is not a pass.
- Phenotype similarity: pass. The design is inside the calibrated shape distribution (body p 1). This is shape similarity to real specimens only, and it says nothing about features the comparison doesn't read.
- Lean check: cannot-assess. No Lean law could be evaluated (30 cannot-evaluate, 5 out of scope). No accepted-law violation was found, but that is not a pass.
- Functional resolution: cannot-assess. No differences were classified and the ledger is empty. An empty ledger is not evidence that there are no differences.
- Physics check: fail. The design cannot glide. The reachable launch speed is 15.00 m/s, against a minimum flight speed of 21.75 m/s. The glide criterion was met in 0.0% of 200 draws (median 0 m). Two standing checks also failed. reaches_minimum_flight_speed misses by 6.75 m/s. lifting_area_supports_mass shows the lifting area is 2.10x too small (26.04 cm² against 54.76 cm² needed to carry 0.589 N).

Scales not assessed: cell, tissue and organ_system. Organ and body were assessable.

The scorer's composite value (0.4676, flagged plausible: false) is carried through for reference only. No gate feeds it and it is not the verdict.

In short, the design as submitted does not do what was asked: it fails the glide requirement. Most of the other checks could not be assessed.
